text: 路透调查显示，固定收益策略师预计未来几个月美国国债收益率将回落。尽管基准10年期美债收益率录得1994年以来最大季度涨幅，策略师仍坚持长期以来的看跌收益率观点。不过，在过去9个月持续误判收益率走势后，市场对收益率下行的信心正在减弱。部分策略师认为，金融市场已经过度计入美联储一系列加息预期，最终实际加息幅度可能低于市场预期。与此同时，受美以对伊朗战争引发的通胀担忧以及全球主要央行政策利率上升影响，近期多个发达经济体政府融资成本升至数十年来高位。科技巨头为人工智能基础设施建设大举举债，同时美国国债发行增加，也进一步推高收益率压力。路透对近60名策略师在10月
text_en: A Reuters survey shows fixed-income strategists expect U.S. Treasury yields to fall in the coming months. Despite the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield posting its largest quarterly gain since 1994, strategists are sticking to their long-held bearish yield view. However, after persistently misjudging yield trends over the past nine months, market confidence in falling yields is waning. Some strategists believe financial markets have already priced in too much of a series of Fed rate hikes, and the actual pace of hikes may ultimately be lower than market expectations. Meanwhile, amid inflation concerns triggered by the U.S.-Israel war against Iran and rising policy rates at major global central banks, government funding costs in several developed economies have recently risen to multi-decade highs. Tech giants borrowing heavily for AI infrastructure buildout, along with increased U.S. Treasury issuance, have further added to yield pressure. Reuters surveyed nearly 60 strategists in October
